timbres.label: GM harpsichord, slot 1
timbres._note: The dry anchor. Mono, and silent to the numerical floor two and a half seconds after note-off, so nothing here is a room. Modest as an instrument, decisive as a reference: every level and every decay measured against it is the instrument alone.

timbres.label: Baroque registration, slot 3
timbres._note: The main reference. A plain 8' registration in the baroque style, and the shortest decay of the eight slots.

timbres.label: 8ft + 4ft registration, slot 4
timbres._note: The 8'+4' registration, and the evidence for it: this is the only slot whose second harmonic outweighs its first, which is the octave rank sounding as a rank rather than as a brighter tone.

timbres.label: The same instrument in a space, slot 7
timbres._note: The same instrument in a space, kept as the check on the room correction rather than as a timbre target.
